record.question: If a patient is readmitted within one month after discharge with the same condition, what note should be written:
record.explanation: Answer C: Interval note. An interval history/note records relevant events since the prior discharge or visit; it is used to document a readmission interval. Source/context note: Exact terminology can vary between record systems. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK482263/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
